concerns.concern: Placeholder validation moved from use sites to config load only
concerns.why: Templates and commands not routed through validateConfig (default prompt, built-in dispatchers, direct callers) are no longer checked, so an unknown placeholder now passes silently.

concerns.concern: DispatchRunner.start returns Result instead of throwing
concerns.why: Callers in session.ts must now check .ok or a busy/unknown-dispatcher failure is silently dropped, and spawn errors are truncated to their first line.

concerns.concern: CLI main maps Results to exit codes; model ranking awaited inline
concerns.why: Every load failure now exits 1 via fail(), repoRoot failure falls back silently, and a rejected rankWithModel still reaches the catch-all while --json and default modes now share one path.

concerns.concern: Config loading and validation return Result; ConfigError removed
concerns.why: Every throw site must become an early return; a missed propagation (placeholders, policy, layered repo file) would accept invalid config, and TOML errors are now cut to the first line.

concerns.concern: Git and gh sources and target resolution return Result
concerns.why: Each git/gh step must short-circuit on failure; run() still throws on a missing binary despite its doc, and invalid gh JSON is now a returned error.

concerns.concern: try/catch replaced with attempt in parse, cache, model, signal
concerns.why: attempt keeps only the error's first line, so JSON-parse notes and model-resolution reasons can lose detail; the swallow-all sites should behave identically.
